records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Hey, @.#$e#I always knew we would become good friends. It was written in the stars!|Hi, @.$u#$e#I always knew we'd become close like this...
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Hoy, @.#$e#Alam ko noon pa man na magiging matalik tayong magkaibigan. Nakasulat iyon sa mga bituin!|Kumusta, @.$u#$e#Alam ko noon pa man na magiging ganito tayo kalapit...

records.source: I hope you're farming in a sustainable way. The valley's ecosystem is fragile!#$e#How do I know? I have a strong gut-feeling!
records.translation: Sana ay nagsasaka ka sa paraang napangangalagaan ang kalikasan. Marupok ang ekosistema ng lambak!#$e#Paano ko nalaman? Malakas ang kutob ko!

records.source: Sometimes the flowers speak to me... each one has a different story to tell!
records.translation: Minsan ay kinakausap ako ng mga bulaklak... bawat isa ay may naiibang kuwentong sasabihin!

records.source: Ah, spring. The season of pastels. I actually prefer jewel tones, myself.#$b#Oh, excuse me! I was mumbling about fashion again, wasn't I?
records.translation: Ah, tagsibol. Ang panahon ng mga kulay pastel. Sa totoo lang, mas gusto ko ang matitingkad na kulay ng hiyas.#$b#Ah, paumanhin! Nagbubulong-bulong na naman ako tungkol sa moda, hindi ba?

records.source: I like making my own clothes, but it's not easy to get cloth.#$e#And it's such a long trip to the city.
records.translation: Gusto kong gumawa ng sarili kong damit, pero hindi madaling makakuha ng tela.#$e#At napakalayo pa ng biyahe papunta sa lungsod.

records.source: Do you ever think about the texture of fabric, @? Each texture has a distinct personality... feel my dress... see?
records.translation: Naiisip mo ba kung minsan ang tekstura ng tela, @? May natatanging personalidad ang bawat tekstura... hipuin mo ang damit ko... kita mo?

records.source: Hi @!#$e#Do you raise sheep in your barn? You can turn their wool into beautiful bolts of cloth!#$e#You'll need a loom, though. You can make them yourself if you know the crafting recipe.
records.translation: Kumusta, @!#$e#Nag-aalaga ka ba ng tupa sa Kamalig mo? Magagawa mong rolyo ng magandang tela ang lana nila!#$e#Pero kakailanganin mo ng Habihan. Makagagawa ka nito kung alam mo ang resipe sa paglikha.

records.source: This house was left in our care by my parents. They've been traveling the world for the last two years.#$e#We have no idea when they'll be back.#$e#I enjoy living here, though. It's a beautiful area and the town is nice.
records.translation: Ipinagkatiwala sa amin ng mga magulang ko ang bahay na ito. Dalawang taon na silang naglalakbay sa buong mundo.#$e#Hindi namin alam kung kailan sila babalik.#$e#Pero gusto kong manirahan dito. Maganda ang lugar at kaaya-aya ang bayan.

records.source: Thank you!
records.translation: Salamat!

records.source: Um... Okay. Sorry you didn't like it. I guess those three years of practice were a complete waste...$s
records.translation: Um... Sige. Paumanhin kung hindi mo iyon nagustuhan. Siguro ay lubos na nasayang ang tatlong taon kong pagsasanay...$s

records.source: Did you really think so? That's exactly the effect I was shooting for!$h#$b#I'm so glad you liked it.
records.translation: Talaga bang ganoon ang palagay mo? Iyon mismo ang epektong hinahangad ko!$h#$b#Natutuwa akong nagustuhan mo iyon.

records.source: Haley is a picky eater. It's so hard to cook for her.
records.translation: Mapili sa pagkain si Haley. Napakahirap magluto para sa kaniya.

records.source: Eating healthy is very important to me. I want to live a long and active life.
records.translation: Napakahalaga sa akin ng masustansiyang pagkain. Gusto kong mabuhay nang matagal at masigla.

records.source: Haley and I get along much better now that she's moved out. I look forward to her visits!
records.translation: Mas maayos na ang pagsasamahan namin ni Haley ngayong lumipat na siya. Inaasam ko ang mga pagdalaw niya!

records.source: Hello there, @.#$e#I feel lazy today.$u
records.translation: Kumusta, @.#$e#Tinatamad ako ngayon.$u

records.source: I feel bad for Linus. People judge him, but he's just living a different lifestyle.$u#$e#I wish everyone could learn to be accepting of others.
records.translation: Naaawa ako kay Linus. Hinuhusgahan siya ng mga tao, pero naiiba lang ang paraan ng pamumuhay niya.$u#$e#Sana ay matutuhan ng lahat na tanggapin ang ibang tao.

records.source: Hi, @! We've become decent friends, haven't we?$h#$e#That's fine with me. You're a cool guy.^I'm glad.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @! Maganda na ang pagkakaibigan natin, hindi ba?$h#$e#Ayos iyon sa akin. Astig kang lalaki.^Natutuwa ako.$h

records.source: Hi, @! We've become decent friends, haven't we?$h#$e#This may sound weird, but I've always been certain this would happen.
records.translation: Kumusta, @! Maganda na ang pagkakaibigan natin, hindi ba?$h#$e#Baka kakatwa itong pakinggan, pero lagi akong nakatitiyak na mangyayari ito.

records.source: It doesn't rain much in summer, does it?#$e#That just means more watering work for you, huh?#$e#Or do you enjoy the sunny weather?
records.translation: Hindi gaanong umuulan sa tag-init, hindi ba?#$e#Ibig sabihin lang niyan ay mas marami kang gawaing pagdidilig, ano?#$e#O nasisiyahan ka ba sa maaraw na panahon?

records.source: I consider the bees and butterflies to be my special friends!
records.translation: Itinuturing kong mga natatangi kong kaibigan ang mga bubuyog at paruparo!

records.source: If I wasn't so busy I'd come help you on the farm!#$e#But Gus would be upset if I had another job...$s
records.translation: Kung hindi ako abala, pupunta sana akong tumulong sa bukid mo!#$e#Pero magagalit si Gus kung may iba akong trabaho...$s

records.source: You know, I'm sure Gus would understand if I wanted to leave the Saloon someday.#$b#There's so much out there, I can't stay a barmaid forever.$u
records.translation: Alam mo, sigurado akong mauunawaan ni Gus kung gugustuhin kong umalis sa Saloon balang araw.#$b#Napakaraming bagay sa labas; hindi ako maaaring manatiling serbidora sa bar habambuhay.$u

records.source: Don't overwork yourself or you might end up in Harvey's clinic!
records.translation: Huwag mong pagurin nang husto ang sarili mo, kung hindi ay baka mapunta ka sa klinika ni Harvey!

records.source: Hi @!
records.translation: Kumusta, @!

records.source: It's around this time of year that my good friends visit the region... I mean the parrots!
records.translation: Sa ganitong panahon ng taon dumadalaw sa rehiyon ang mabubuti kong kaibigan... Ang ibig kong sabihin ay ang mga loro!

records.source: Well, fall is here. Time to plant some new crops, huh?
records.translation: Aba, narito na ang taglagas. Oras na para magtanim ng mga bagong pananim, ano?

records.source: $d bus#I'm visiting Sandy today. We're best friends!#$e#I'm really happy that the bus is repaired.|*Sigh*... If only that old bus were fixed, I would've visited my friend Sandy today...$s
records.translation: $d bus#Dadalawin ko si Sandy ngayon. Matalik kaming magkaibigan!#$e#Talagang masaya akong naayos na ang bus.|*Buntong-hininga*... Kung naayos lang sana ang lumang bus na iyon, dadalawin ko sana ngayon ang kaibigan kong si Sandy...$s

records.source: It's good weather for a picnic, isn't it?
records.translation: Magandang panahon para sa piknik, hindi ba?

records.source: If I didn't have to work I'd suggest we go on a nice picnic!
records.translation: Kung hindi ako kailangang magtrabaho, yayayain kitang magpiknik!

records.source: Hello. Did you have a good summer?
records.translation: Kumusta. Naging maganda ba ang tag-init mo?

records.source: Hi @! I bet your farm did great this past summer, huh?#$e#You're an excellent farmer.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @! Siguradong napakasagana ng bukid mo nitong nakaraang tag-init, ano?#$e#Napakahusay mong magsasaka.$h

records.source: My friend runs a shop in the desert. If you ever go there stop in and say hi for me.#$e#I think she sells some rare products.
records.translation: May tindahan sa disyerto ang kaibigan ko. Kung makapunta ka roon, dumaan ka at kumustahin mo siya para sa akin.#$e#Sa tingin ko'y nagbebenta siya ng ilang pambihirang produkto.

records.source: Are you friends with Clint? He's a nice guy, if you get to know him.#$e#He gets lonely working in his shop all day. But he's so shy he has trouble making new friends.
records.translation: Kaibigan mo ba si Clint? Mabait siya kapag nakilala mo siya nang husto.#$e#Nalulungkot siya sa maghapong pagtatrabaho sa tindahan niya. Pero napakamahiyain niya kaya nahihirapan siyang magkaroon ng mga bagong kaibigan.

records.source: I think Clint's mad at me. He never looks at me anymore...$u#$e#I always thought we were friends.$u
records.translation: Sa tingin ko'y galit sa akin si Clint. Hindi na niya ako tinitingnan...$u#$e#Akala ko noon ay magkaibigan kami.$u

records.source: Another beautiful fall day.#$e#It's a pity it'll soon be over.
records.translation: Isa na namang magandang araw ng taglagas.#$e#Sayang at malapit na itong matapos.

records.source: Smell that clean air? It's lovely, isn't it?#$b#I just fear that the Joja Co.'s of the world will take this away from us.$u
records.translation: Naaamoy mo ang malinis na hangin? Kaibig-ibig, hindi ba?#$b#Natatakot lang akong agawin ito sa atin ng mga kompanyang tulad ng Joja.$u

records.source: Keep your mind open and some interesting things might take root.#$e#Anyway, how is your day going?
records.translation: Panatilihing bukas ang isip mo at baka mag-ugat ang ilang kawili-wiling bagay.#$e#Siyanga pala, kumusta ang araw mo?

records.source: I don't have any huge plans for life. I prefer not to stress about the future.
records.translation: Wala akong malalaking plano sa buhay. Mas gusto kong huwag mabahala tungkol sa hinaharap.

records.source: Nothing like a sunny Sunday to lift the spirits!
records.translation: Walang katulad ang maaraw na Linggo upang pasiglahin ang kalooban!

records.source: There's so many invisible barriers holding us back. Why can't people learn to let go and explore their true potential?#$e#Me? Well, you know what they say... 'You can't cage a wild Junimo'.
records.translation: Napakaraming di-nakikitang hadlang ang pumipigil sa atin. Bakit hindi matutuhan ng mga tao na kumawala at tuklasin ang tunay nilang kakayahan?#$e#Ako? Aba, alam mo ang sabi nila... “Hindi mo maikukulong ang isang ligaw na Junimo”.

records.source: You're such a nice person, @! Thanks for being my friend.$h
records.translation: Napakabuti mong tao, @! Salamat sa pagiging kaibigan ko.$h

records.source: Be careful an icicle doesn't fall on your head!
records.translation: Mag-ingat kang huwag mahulugan sa ulo ng tipak ng yelo!

records.source: Be careful an icicle doesn't fall on your head! I wouldn't want you to get hurt!
records.translation: Mag-ingat kang huwag mahulugan sa ulo ng tipak ng yelo! Ayaw kong masaktan ka!

records.source: Oh, hello @!$h#$e#You must be getting very good at farming by now, huh?
records.translation: Oh, kumusta, @!$h#$e#Siguradong napakahusay mo nang magsaka ngayon, ano?

records.source: I bet you're an excellent farmer by now!
records.translation: Siguradong napakahusay mo nang magsaka ngayon!

records.source: I think my hair is frozen solid...$s
records.translation: Sa tingin ko'y nanigas na sa yelo ang buhok ko...$s

records.source: Haley and I aren't made for such a big house. It's a hassle to keep it clean.#$e#Ah well. I really shouldn't be complaining.#$e#Your farmhouse seems nice and cozy.$h
records.translation: Hindi bagay sa aming dalawa ni Haley ang ganito kalaking bahay. Napakahirap panatilihin itong malinis.#$e#Hay naku. Hindi talaga ako dapat nagrereklamo.#$e#Mukhang maganda at maginhawa ang Bahay-Bukid mo.$h

records.source: It must be so cold for the poor fish.$s#$e#I wonder if any fish hibernate? Maybe I should ask Demetrius.
records.translation: Siguradong giniginaw nang husto ang mga kawawang isda.$s#$e#Nagtutulog-taglamig kaya ang ilang isda? Baka dapat kong tanungin si Demetrius.

records.source: If I wasn't so busy I'd help you dig around in that cave by the lake.#$e#I bet there are some powerful crystals inside there.
records.translation: Kung hindi ako abala, tutulungan sana kitang maghukay sa loob ng yungib na iyon sa tabi ng lawa.#$e#Siguradong may ilang makapangyarihang kristal sa loob niyon.

records.source: Do you know how to cook 'Bean Hotpot'?#$e#I like that dish quite a bit.$h%revealtaste:Emily:207#$e#It's hard to get fresh ingredients in the winter, huh?
records.translation: Alam mo bang magluto ng “Mainit na Nilagang Patani”?#$e#Talagang gusto ko ang pagkaing iyon.$h%revealtaste:Emily:207#$e#Mahirap makakuha ng mga sariwang sangkap sa taglamig, ano?

records.source: Hi!#$e#...Yes?
records.translation: Kumusta!#$e#...Oo?

records.source: My sister and I might fight sometimes, but I would really miss her if she left.#$e#I think she'll become a very nice young lady some day... Don't tell her I said that.$h#$e#So, is there anything you want to talk about?
records.translation: Maaaring nag-aaway kami kung minsan ng kapatid ko, pero talagang mangungulila ako sa kaniya kung aalis siya.#$e#Sa tingin ko'y magiging napakabuti niyang dalaga balang araw... Huwag mong sabihin sa kaniya na sinabi ko iyon.$h#$e#Aba, may gusto ka bang pag-usapan?

records.source: Say hi to my sister for me! And remind her to visit me tomorrow.
records.translation: Kumustahin mo ang kapatid ko para sa akin! At ipaalala mong dalawin niya ako bukas.
